title: Ashvale Rising Anew
author: A. M. Iversen
blurb: Rafael Vasquez, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
